scope: Pre-GPU audit of v10 raw state-pass capture, unique physical byte accounting, telemetry reconciliation, and fail-closed postprocessing for the frozen naive path.
findings: v10 rebuilds every total from raw StatePassRecord objects and never imports the historical 58x value.

The fixed naive graph must contain one shared and eight private logical segments, exactly 30 operation labels over all nine segments, 270 pass records, and 522 derived graph edges; missing, duplicated, overlapping, or renamed physical events fail closed.

Logical bytes are counted once, while native endpoint reads/writes, GPU and host intermediates, D2H, and H2D occupy mutually exclusive accounting buckets. Temporary allocation capacity and checksum work are reported separately from movement amplification.

Unique D2H/H2D sizes and counts are reconciled against independently recorded CUDA operations, and host temporary totals/peaks are reconciled against the allocation tracker with zero live checkpoint buffers required.

External, full physical, avoidable lower-bound, and critical-path amplifications are independently derived from the v10 denominator and raw passes. The artifact explicitly records the conservative avoidable-byte semantics and the synchronous naive critical-path definition.

Every enriched state pass records operation, source/destination memory, logical segment and range, bytes read/written/transferred, temporary bytes, processor, wall time, CUDA overlap where available, required/avoidable classification, and fusion classification.

test_evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=python:experiments/branchfabric uv run --locked pytest -q tests/python/test_experiment_004_accounting.py tests/python/test_gpu_reclamation_v10_validity.py tests/python/test_experiment_004_v10_scientific_contract.py tests/python/test_experiment_004_gpu_harness.py -k 'movement or scientific or v10 or accounting or fail_closed'

post_run_rechecks_required: Recompute and compare all v10 byte totals from the sealed raw run rather than projecting the historical amplification.
Verify the published state-pass graph and amplification-decomposition plots use these raw v10 records and do not sum shared per-segment operation time as independent wall time.
